messages:
maya: Heads-up — Brightlane asked to run a distributor-led pilot next month. They want a quick credentialing flow, tenant provisioning, and a short cost sprint to lock pricing. Can we scope?

sam: +1. Do we have an onboarding checklist we can share? They need SSO, SCIM, and audit logs for the pilot.

devon: I have a checklist but needs updates for Dedicated vs Hosted options. Key Qs: will Brightlane use our hosted API or a Dedicated tenant? That changes pricing + network setup.

elena (Brightlane): We prefer Hosted to move faster, but we need VPC egress policy confirmation and an SLA for 99.9% during pilot. Also security questionnaire attached.

rachel: @elena thanks. Can you paste the security questionnaire link here? we'll triage. Also SLA for pilot is possible with a simple commitment but need to confirm traffic estimates.

elena (Brightlane): https://files.brightlane.example/pilot-security-q.pdf — question 4 asks about key rotation and HSM support.

josh: For keys we support KMS integrations (AWS/GCP) and rotation policies; HSM is enterprise, might be a Private deployment. I'll add suggested answers.

maya: Dev team, action items: 1) Provide draft questionnaire responses (security) 2) Tenant provisioning runbook for Hosted pilot 3) Pricing for 30-day pilot with expected requests 4) Network/egress notes. Who owns each?

devon: I can do the tenant runbook + network notes. Will include required headers, allowed egress IP ranges, and sample NAT rules.

sam: I'll handle pricing. Need a ballpark of token counts and peak rps from Brightlane to size commit vs burst. @elena can you share estimates?

elena (Brightlane): We expect ~5k prompt calls/day, spike to 50 rps during demos. Token mix: 75% short embeddings, 25% long generations (~600 tokens).

sam: Got it. I'll run cost sim and propose two options: a no-commit hosted pilot rate + a reserved burst option.

josh: I drafted security responses. Key points: we support KMS (AWS/GCP), audit logs retained 90 days on Hosted pilot, SCIM provisioning supported, SSO via SAML/OIDC. For HSM note: only for Private deployments. I'll paste snippet: ```We integrate with customer KMS for key management; HSM-backed key storage available on Private deployments. Audit logs export via S3/Cloud Logging.```

rachel: Nice. @maya we should also prepare a short run of the provisioning CLI for them. Example: 
```
# create pilot tenant
redwood-cli create-tenant --name brightlane-pilot --region us-west-2 --plan hosted --admins elena@brightlane.com
# grant api key
redwood-cli keys create --tenant brightlane-pilot --label demo-key
```
Include note about rotating keys after onboarding.

maya: Perfect. Two blockers we need help on: 1) legal needs a single-page contract addendum for the pilot (pricing + data handling) 2) security wants confirmation on egress IP ranges for their network team.

devon: Egress ranges: 34.210.128.0/20, 52.23.0.0/18, and CDN endpoints — I'll export a concise CIDR list and send to security.

elena (Brightlane): Legal pinged — can we get the addendum by EOD Friday? Pilot target start next Tue.

sam: I'll draft the pricing addendum today and loop in finance for a quick signoff.

rachel: I'll attach the provisioning runbook + CLI steps to the shared drive: https://redwood.shares/pilot/brightlane — will update with post-checklist.

maya: Thanks all. Proposed owners: Security responses + HSM wording: josh; Tenant runbook + egress: devon; Pricing & addendum draft: sam; provisioning docs: rachel; Biz contact: elena.

deploy-bot: Deployed draft tenant-runbook to https://redwood.shares/pilot/brightlane/runbook-v1.md at 2109876700

maya: Great momentum. Next sync Thursday 10am PT to finalize addendum and handoff to legal. :thumbsup:

elena (Brightlane): Thanks team — appreciate the fast turnaround. Looking forward to the pilot. :rocket:
